## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-2003. The issue was that the catalog-search deployment was missing a **startup probe**. The application takes ~55 seconds to load a 12.4 GiB index snapshot into memory, but the liveness probe was configured to start checking after only 30 seconds with a tight failure threshold, causing the pods to be killed before startup completed. This created a restart loop.

The fix is to add a startup probe that allows the application up to 5 minutes to initialize, while keeping the aggressive liveness probe for detecting deadlocks during normal operation. I've provided the ticket owner with the specific configuration recommendation.
